capabilities_done: wire: Envelope{bridge_version,correlation_id,idempotency_key,actor,resource_id,expected_revision,lease_epoch,body} with bodies grant_check|commit|lookup|job_admit|job_release|diagnostic and Reply{bridge_version,correlation_id,result}; canonical compact JSON (struct field order); decode refuses unknown/duplicate fields, foreign bridge_version (read first, alone), leading/trailing bytes, oversize, invalid DomainId, invalid actor/key, non-lowercase hex, with 12 distinct stable codes; encode validates first so it never emits what decode refuses

host: HostBridge (bytes in, bytes out) + TransientHost (memory only): grants per principal/resource/action with revoke (revoked vs missing), commit rechecks the grant even for a known key, idempotency bound to principal+resource+binding (conflict discloses nothing), lease-epoch fence, expected-revision compare, successor == expected+1, monotonic receipts with opaque host_ref, job admission (slots+bytes), FaultPlan{DropAck,RevokeBeforeCommit,BumpEpoch}, independent inspection API

adapter: BridgePorts<H>.grants()/commits()/jobs() implement session GrantPort/CommitPort/JobPort (session slice 2, 6a162da) over envelopes; no/undecodable/mismatched reply => denied grant, refused job, commit outcome Unknown (never Rejected); lookup() for reconcile; one best-effort diagnostic envelope per terminal commit result; sent-request log for golden/zero-bytes proofs

DESCRIPTOR with storage NONE and later_host_adapters (7 entries, all NOT_IMPLEMENTED_HOST_ONLY); example kernel-bindings-consumer --descriptor|--roundtrip|--revoke|--drop-ack|--cancel printing the receipt chain
